description: Deletes one candidate from the recruiting board (candidate_id, from read the candidate), as Delete on their record does. It is a hard delete and cannot be undone; to keep the person but stop working them, set status withdrawn or rejected with update_candidate instead. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat deletes nothing more.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: delete_recruiting_candidate
title: Delete a recruiting candidate
